en.name: God of Ug
en.ability: One Ug hat. When wearing the Ug hat, you must speak one sound at a time but vote twice. If you fail, pass the Ug hat.

revisions.v1: One Ug hat. When wearing the Ug hat, you must speak one sound at a time but vote twice. If you fail, pass the Ug hat.

zh.name: 讷神
zh.ability: 会有一顶讷帽。当玩家戴着讷帽的时候，只能说单音节词，但投票算作两票。如果违反规则，讷帽会被转移。
